description: This Dart source file defines the Env utility class that handles loading environment variables from a '.env' file, either through Flutter assets or the local file system. It provides a reliable way to load environment configurations in Flutter applications outside of relying solely on the process working directory.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class for loading environment variables from a '.env' file, supporting both asset-based and file-based loading strategies. Designed to ensure consistent environment configuration loading in Flutter apps.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from a '.env' file, trying first from Flutter assets and then from the local file system, with error handling and debugging support.
